environment: Local Anvil and local Bee, public test wallets injected into isolated real Chromium contexts
checks: Client wallet owns funding; device bindings registered by distinct wallets
Client-defined Unicode scope stored on Bee and verified against immutable funded terms
Real HTTP request preserves signed scope when a Unicode character crosses chunk boundaries
Browser proof cancellation clears private file selections and sends no acceptance transaction
Account change terminates an initializing browser prover and cannot restore a stale proof
Browser WASM generated and contract-simulated the real proof in 18010ms
Browser-generated proof settles against the deployed Groth16 verifier; reviewer wallet owns the exact bound assignment
Worker signs upload authorization and commits ciphertext locator plus digest onchain; HTTP receives no plaintext or private keys
Independent client browser decrypts actual Bee retrieval; private key survives reload
Client exports authenticated ciphertext and explicitly saves decrypted report; exported ciphertext has no plaintext
Third wallet/browser cannot decrypt the public ciphertext
Rotated key cannot decrypt historical review; explicitly retained previous key can
Provider disconnect removes decrypted content and invalidates wallet session
Same holder credential accepts a second client's job with a different job-scoped nullifier
Second client decrypts its review; first client's wallet and retained device keys cannot decrypt it
Durable revocation advances the root; stale published snapshot is rejected rather than served as current
Both client wallets approve payment to assigned worker after review and credential revocation
Delayed connect cannot restore the prior wallet/device after accountsChanged
390px responsive pilot has no horizontal overflow
All observed browser HTTP request URLs and bodies exclude the holder secret
